You own a property in the UK. Perhaps you already host guests, are considering your first short let, or have a property you would like to put to better use.

The question is how involved you want to be.

PropertyFlow gives you two options. You can use its property management software free for life to manage your own listings, pricing, bookings and guest operations.

Or, if you want to step away from the day to day work, you can explore fully managed hosting with a local PropertyFlow Verified Partner and an operations team behind your property.

The platform connects the work involved in a guest's stay, from listing and booking through communication, changeovers and reporting. You choose the level of involvement that suits you.

If you want someone else to handle the operation, start by submitting your property details. You'll receive a personalised comparison of estimated short let and long let outcomes, then speak with a local Partner where available. Explore Fully Managed Hosting

How Full Property Management Works

Full property management means handing the day to day running of your short term let to a management company and its team. PropertyFlow combines connected property management software with a fully managed service for owners who want to hand over the work.

With fully managed hosting:

  • A local PropertyFlow Verified Partner remains your relationship contact.
  • A named Portfolio Manager oversees the property's day to day operation.
  • The operations team coordinates listings, bookings, pricing and guest communication.
  • Vetted local providers coordinate cleaning, linen, changeovers and maintenance.
  • PropertyFlow applies for and holds the relevant short term let licence or registration where required for managed properties.
  • You receive monthly payouts and an itemised statement of bookings, deductions and applicable tourist tax.

The management fee is tailored to your property and agreed before you sign. Cleaning and maintenance are charged at cost, without a PropertyFlow mark up.

If you prefer to manage the property yourself, you can use PropertyFlow's software free for life.

Choose your level of involvement. Use PropertyFlow's software free for life to manage your own property, or explore fully managed hosting.

Connect the work behind every stay. PropertyFlow brings together listings, bookings, pricing, guest communication, changeovers and reporting.

What Does Full Property Management Include?

(PropertyFlow coordinates the day-to-day operation of a short-term let, from bookings and guest communication to cleaning, compliance and monthly reporting)

Property management services in the UK vary. Some companies find tenants or guests and leave the rest to the owner. Others take responsibility for the ongoing work involved in running a property.

PropertyFlow supports more than 31 booking channels and connects the stages of a guest's stay through one operational workflow. The platform brings listing and booking activity together with pricing, guest communication, changeovers and reporting. With fully managed hosting, the team coordinates these tasks on your behalf.

PropertyFlow's managed short let service covers the following:

Listings, bookings and pricing

Your property is listed across relevant booking channels, and AI Cognito Pricing adjusts nightly rates in response to demand and seasonality. Booking administration is handled through the back office.

Guest communication

The back office manages guest messages and scheduled communications. Your local Partner can be involved when an issue needs personal attention or escalation.

Cleaning, changeovers and maintenance

Vetted Service Partners and Maintenance Partners coordinate cleaning, linen, changeovers and maintenance. These services are charged at cost, without a PropertyFlow mark up.

Licensing and compliance

Short term let requirements differ across Scotland, England, Wales and Northern Ireland. PropertyFlow applies for and holds the relevant licence or registration where required for managed properties, and keeps safety documents and renewal dates organised with you.

Payments and reporting

Booking money is held in a designated client account, separate from PropertyFlow's own funds. You receive monthly payouts and an itemised statement showing bookings, deductions and applicable tourist tax.

You can read more about the arrangement in PropertyFlow's terms for property owners.

Who Actually Manages Your Property?

(PropertyFlow combines a local relationship contact with a central operations team and local service providers to coordinate short-term-let management)

When comparing property management firms in the UK, ask who will handle the work after you sign. You should know who to contact, who coordinates the operation and who is responsible for the contractual arrangement.

The level of support depends on the option you choose. If you manage your own property, you use the software to run your operation. With fully managed hosting, a local PropertyFlow Verified Partner stays your relationship contact, while the Portfolio Manager, operations team and local providers coordinate the day to day work.

PropertyFlow has three parts to its management model:

Your local PropertyFlow Verified Partner stays your relationship contact and helps you understand the property, the local market and the proposed arrangement.

Your named Portfolio Manager coordinates the daily operation and helps resolve issues.

The back office and local service providers handle bookings, guest communication, pricing, cleaning, changeovers, maintenance and compliance administration.

For example, imagine you own a two bedroom flat in Edinburgh but live in Manchester. A guest checks out on Sunday and the next booking arrives that afternoon. The team needs to coordinate the changeover, make sure the property is ready and deal with any guest questions. You should not have to arrange every part of that process yourself.

That is the purpose of full management: giving someone responsibility for coordinating the work while keeping you informed about your property.

What Are Full Property Management Fees in the UK?

The two options have different costs. Self-management software is free for life. Fully managed hosting has a tailored fee based on the property and the agreed arrangement. Before committing, understand exactly what the fee covers and which services cost extra.

Before choosing a property management company in the UK, ask:

  • What does the management fee cover?
  • Is VAT added to the quoted fee?
  • Are cleaning, linen and maintenance included or charged separately?
  • Are there additional compliance or licensing costs?
  • How often will you receive payments and financial statements?
  • What notice period applies if you decide to end the arrangement?

With PropertyFlow, the management fee is agreed per property before you sign and stated in your Landlord Agreement, plus VAT where applicable. Cleaning and maintenance are charged at cost without a mark up. Licensing and compliance costs are charged only with your approval.

Utilities, broadband, consumables and other property running costs should also be included in your calculations.

You can review the details on the PropertyFlow property owner page before submitting your enquiry.

Should You Choose Full Management or Manage the Property Yourself?

The right option depends on how much of the work you want to handle yourself.

If you enjoy hosting, live near the property and have time to coordinate bookings, guests and cleaners, PropertyFlow's free software lets you manage your own operation.

If you have a full time job, live elsewhere or own several properties, fully managed hosting may suit you better. A local Partner and the operations team coordinate the work while you stay informed about your property.

Consider a landlord with a full time job who owns a holiday cottage in the Lake District. During a busy summer weekend, a guest may need help with check in while a cleaner reports a maintenance issue. The landlord must coordinate both while managing their other commitments. With full management, the operational team coordinates those tasks.

The financial comparison matters too. A short let can earn different amounts across the year, and costs can rise during quieter periods. A long let may offer more predictable rental income, depending on the tenancy and market.

PropertyFlow's personalised property report compares estimated short let and long let outcomes for your address, helping you assess the options before making a decision.

How to Submit Your Property for Full Management

(From your initial property enquiry to reviewing the management terms, here are the four steps to explore full management with PropertyFlow)

You can enquire even if you have never hosted a guest before.

1. Tell us about your property

Complete the Own a Property form. Provide the address, number of bedrooms, guest capacity, property standard and contact details.

2. Review your personalised report

PropertyFlow uses your details to estimate the potential outcomes of short and long letting. The report uses third party market data, the ONS private rents index and PropertyFlow platform data. Actual income and costs may differ.

3. Speak with a local Partner

Your enquiry is passed to the PropertyFlow Verified Partner for your area. They can discuss the property, the report and what management would involve. If a Partner is not available for your area, you will be told.

4. Review the agreement

Before management begins, PropertyFlow provides the Landlord Agreement setting out the management fee, responsibilities, other costs and notice arrangements. Review the terms before deciding whether to proceed.

Prefer to manage the property yourself? PropertyFlow's self-management software is free for life, so you can choose the level of involvement that suits you.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is PropertyFlow free to use?

PropertyFlow's self-management software is free for life. Owners who choose fully managed hosting pay a tailored management fee agreed before signing.

Can I manage my own property with PropertyFlow?

Yes. You can use PropertyFlow's software to manage your own property. If you prefer to hand over the day-to-day work, you can explore fully managed hosting with a local PropertyFlow Verified Partner.

How many booking channels does PropertyFlow support?

PropertyFlow supports more than 31 booking channels. Check the current platform for the full list of supported channels.

What is the difference between self-management and fully managed hosting?

With self-management, you use PropertyFlow's software and handle the operation yourself. With fully managed hosting, a local PropertyFlow Verified Partner remains your relationship contact while the operations team coordinates the day-to-day work for a tailored fee.

How do I submit my property for full management in the UK?

Complete PropertyFlow's Own a Property form. Provide your property's details to receive a personalised comparison of short and long letting and connect with a local Partner where available.

How much do property management services cost in the UK?

Fees vary by provider, property and service level. Short let management fees may be calculated differently from traditional long let fees. Ask what the fee covers, whether VAT applies and which expenses are charged separately. PropertyFlow agrees its management fee per property before you sign.

What is included in full property management?

Depending on the provider, full management can include listing administration, bookings, guest communication, pricing, cleaning coordination, maintenance and compliance administration. Check the proposed agreement to understand the exact responsibilities.

Do I need an existing Airbnb listing?

No. You can submit your property before hosting guests. The initial report and discussion help you understand the potential options and what preparation may be needed.

Can I use full management if I live abroad?

Yes, you can enquire about a property you own in the UK while living overseas. Your local Partner remains your relationship contact, while the back office coordinates the operation. Your agreement explains how communication and decisions are handled.

What if I already have a property manager?

You can still enquire about your options. Before changing providers, review your existing agreement, including notice periods, future bookings and any fees associated with ending the arrangement.

Can I submit a property in the UK that is for sale?

If you are considering buying a property in the UK for sale and later letting it as a short term rental, you can use the enquiry process to explore its potential. Check the property's planning position, licensing requirements, lease restrictions and other relevant conditions before buying or committing to short letting.

Who is responsible for the short term let licence?

Licensing rules depend on the property's location. For properties managed under the PropertyFlow Partner arrangement, PropertyFlow applies for and holds the relevant licence or registration where required. You can learn more about its compliance services.

You do not need to work out every detail before making an inquiry. Start with the property, compare the letting options and discuss the management arrangement with a local Partner.

Complete the form to receive your personalised report and explore whether full management is right for you. Get started with PropertyFlow
